Generalist content writing, retail HR, and unfocused reporting are real jobs, but they rarely clear Rs 8-10 LPA even after 5-7 years without a deliberate pivot into a higher-paying lane like the ones on this list.

The data above says otherwise. Policy consulting, corporate law, and HR/L&D leadership all clear Rs 40-55 LPA-plus at senior levels, on par with many engineering-track corporate roles. The subject you studied matters less than the lane and the pivot you make inside it.
